mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is 82 degrees with clear skies near the Verona Public Library, and the moon is currently a waxing crescent.

The City of Verona has announced that road construction along Highway M will begin on August 18th, requiring traffic to shift while utility work is completed. Also, the Senior Center is seeking volunteers to support their services and encourages anyone interested to apply online or stop by for a form.

There is a busy weekend ahead, with live music at Baileys Run and Lake Lou-ee plus a Girls Try Hockey event happening today. Looking ahead to tomorrow, the Epic User Group Meeting is taking place along with yoga classes at Insight Wellness.
In a report covering August 3rd through August 10th, police noted that on August 6th, an officer observed a vehicle driving erratically, leading to the arrest of a driver for a fourth O W I offence.
The Culver's flavor of the day is Mint Cookie, and they are open until 10 PM tonight so there is plenty of time to stop by for a scoop.
